hooks.command: if [ ! -f apps/mobile/.env.local ] || [ ! -d node_modules ] || { [ "$(cd "$(git rev-parse --git-common-dir)/.." && pwd -P)" != "$(pwd -P)" ] && [ ! -f .lane ]; }; then jq -n '{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"SessionStart",additionalContext:"This worktree is not set up: apps/mobile/.env.local, node_modules or .lane is missing, because git worktree add brings only tracked files. Run ./scripts/setup-worktree.sh before running the app, the tests or the e2e suite. Without .env.local the app throws EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL is not set at module scope, which surfaces as three misleading expo-router errors. Without .lane every lane-derived command refuses to run."}}'; fi

out=$(bash scripts/lane-env.sh 2>&1) || exit 0; slot=$(printf '%s\n' "$out" | sed -n 's/^LANE_SLOT=//p'); branch=$(printf '%s\n' "$out" | sed -n 's/^LANE_BRANCH=//p'); branch=${branch:-"a detached HEAD"}; warn=""; if [ "$slot" = "0" ] && [ "$branch" != "master" ]; then warn="

ATTENTION - this is the MAIN checkout (lane 0) and it is on branch '$branch', not master. ADR 0006 R6 says lane 0 stays on master and feature work happens in a worktree, so do NOT start new work here. Create a worktree first:
  git worktree add -b <name> .claude/worktrees/<name> master
  cd .claude/worktrees/<name> && ./scripts/setup-worktree.sh
That checkout gets ports and a database of its own and leaves lane 0 free. Reviewing or testing an existing branch here is legitimate - this is a warning, not a rule a script can enforce."; fi; jq -n --arg out "$out" --arg warn "$warn" '{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"SessionStart",additionalContext:("This checkout is a lane. Its derived environment:\n" + $out + "\n\nEvery npm script that starts or tests something already runs through scripts/lane-env.sh, so npm run server, mobile, e2e, test:integration and the db:/dict: scripts all use these values with no arguments. Never hardcode a port or a database name; ADR 0006 forbids it. Other checkouts are running on their own ports at the same time - npm run lane:list shows them." + $warn)}}'

paths=$(git status --porcelain -- apps/server/src apps/mobile/src 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$paths" ]; then out=$(./scripts/check-adrs.sh 2>&1); s=$?; if [ $s -ne 0 ]; then jq -n --arg reason "$out" '{decision:"block", reason:$reason}'; fi; fi
